draft.subject: Five minutes to see if it fits
draft.body:
Sarah,

Most clinicians who try JotPsych once and don't buy tell us the same thing: they weren't sure it would work with what they already have in place.

It does. JotPsych works with any EHR. No migration, up in five minutes. You can run it beside the system you use today and switch on your timeline. Or replace it entirely when you're ready.

Notes, billing, e-prescribing, telehealth, and 150+ payer rules checked on every note and claim. One system that follows every dollar from the visit to the bank account.

If you want to see how it handles your templates and your workflow, I can walk you through it in fifteen minutes.

Let me know.

Mark
JotPsych

--

The RECIPIENT RECORD contains no information about her templates or workflow, and the forbidden_facts section explicitly prohibits mentioning specialty, practice details, or other specifics that would justify this assumption.
